notes: Eclipse Loop 1.7.0 - MUTATE turns one sample into sixteen playable variations, and KIT sorts your chops into a real drum kit (kicks, snares, hats) so CHOP -> KIT -> AI DRUMS builds a beat from one sample. - Every pad can hold its own sample: drop a WAV on any pad, and click a pad to edit it in the big waveform. Pad 1 is always the loop. - KEY LOCK now tunes samples into key as they load, and leaves drums alone. - Piano roll: scale highlighting, note names, pitch-bend/CC expression lanes, a velocity lane, note chase, and it finally scrolls past bar 4. - Pattern CHAIN plays A/B/C/D as a song, and patterns carry their own chops. - MIDI export is multi-track with expression curves and the correct time signature. - Arranger: clip volume envelopes, tempo ramps, and automation moved to the audio thread. - Recording: punch in/out with pre-roll, monitor Auto/Off, and a live recording display. - Mixer: PRE/POST sends, narrow strips, phase invert, input trim, 32-bit float export, and knobs that show their values.
